title: heart-rate alarm
task: Wearable heart-rate sensor: 8 readings over 16 s -> abnormal rate alarm yes/no.
signal: 8 heart-rate samples (one per 2 s, 4-bit signed, 8 bpm per unit from resting); the event is a sustained rise of 25-55 bpm or fall of 22-40 bpm ramping in from a random onset, against drift, noise and one-sample motion spikes.
model_size: layers [8, 8, 1], 72 weights (binary hidden, 5-bit output layer); input 8 lanes x 4-bit signed
data: Synthetic data from a seeded generator, not patient data; the detection figures are on synthetic test windows and make no clinical claim.
